basis: Fresh image context. Original source inventoried before candidate spec or author inventory; actual candidate PNGs inspected at 640x1160 and 316x573. No crops, reopens, source pages, new geometry render or science replay.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: Exactly two vertically stacked independent graph panels, upper a and lower b.
comparisons.candidate: Two stacked independent coordinate frames; English (a) Soft magnetic above the narrow loop and (b) Hard magnetic above the wide loop.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: Upper panel has two solid S-shaped branches forming a very narrow nonzero-width loop.
comparisons.candidate: A single closed unfilled 192-vertex polygon expresses both solid branches. Both saturation ends join; the branches remain distinguishable near the origin at 316px. No initial virgin curve, dashed segment or branch arrow was added.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: Lower panel has two solid S-shaped branches forming a substantially wider loop.
comparisons.candidate: A single closed unfilled 192-vertex polygon expresses both solid branches. Branch ordering and joined saturation ends match the source. Zero-crossing separation and enclosed area visibly exceed the upper panel at both inspected widths.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: Both panels retain upward positive I and rightward positive B0 axes, with positive and negative extents. Upper negative I end has a downward terminal; lower negative I end is plain.
comparisons.candidate: Four conceptual axes are represented by six deterministic arrow/segment objects. Five visible arrowheads retain the source-specific direction and terminal distinctions. No curve direction is asserted by an axis arrow.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: Each crossing frame has labels I, B with subscript 0, and zero below/left of the axes intersection.
comparisons.candidate: All six quantity/origin labels are present and correctly assigned. Both zeros remain below/left of the correct origin without obscuring the narrow loop. Both B-subscript-zero labels are readable at the inspected mobile width.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: Left/upper branch has positive I at B0=0 and negative B0 at I=0; right/lower branch has the opposite signs. Upper intercept magnitudes and loop area are smaller than the lower ones.
comparisons.candidate: All four signed crossings per loop are preserved. Independent contour arithmetic confirms nonzero opposite remanence and coercive intercepts and the three upper-versus-lower inequalities, separately from visual inspection.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: No numerical ticks, numbered scale, grid, named points, point markers, measured coordinates or units.
comparisons.candidate: None are visible or authored. Polygon vertices and hidden renderer construction points are not new source points. Finite-grid dimensions and labelled-point relationship coverage are not applicable; objectCount is not used to substitute for them.

comparisons.sourceRequirement: Graph structure, not the historical person or closed-ring apparatus described elsewhere in the prose.
comparisons.candidate: No portrait, person, apparatus, wires, historical dates or cultural symbols appear. Deterministic instructional routing is appropriate.

modernAdditionsSeparatedFromSourceFacts: English soft/hard descriptors are supported by the current bilingual Figure 303a/b prose, not claimed as original pixels.
Panel captions move above the plots without changing source panel identity or order.
Matched qualitative extents and equal display scales implement the stated comparative conditions; no experimental calibration is implied.
Origin-centered symmetry with all 96 opposite vertex pairs per loop is explicitly declared as modern ideal-model regularization, not source measured precision.
Clean deterministic contours replace scanned stroke irregularity while preserving the qualitative loops and signed crossings.
